script_text: Stop! Virgo, the stars are screaming at you right now, and your careful plans are about to break open. Mercury, your ruling planet, is retrograde in Scorpio, squaring Uranus in Gemini and stirring your 3rd House of communication and your 10th House of career. As an earth sign, you crave precision, but this tense square is scrambling your usual order and forcing a sudden, brutally honest conversation you cannot avoid. In love, that retrograde conjunction pulls an old flame or unresolved message back into your 7th House of Partnerships, so do not text impulsively before midnight. For money, Saturn in Aries is pressuring your 8th House of shared resources, so review that contract twice and avoid lending today. Blessing: a delayed payment finally clears unexpectedly tonight. Follow for tomorrow's reading, Virgo, because Mercury goes direct on November thirteenth and everything shifts.
